templates.receivedAck: We received your information request. MediQ is information and navigation only. We will not give medical advice. If this is urgent, contact local emergency services.
templates.providerContacted: We have contacted the listed hospital using the official contact on its profile. This is not an appointment confirmation.
templates.providerResponse: The listed hospital has replied. Please read their message and confirm details directly with them. MediQ does not interpret clinical content.
templates.closed: We have closed this navigation request. You can still contact the hospital directly using the official website or phone on its profile.
templates.missingInfo: We need a non-clinical contact detail to route this request. Please do not send medical records.
templates.complaintAck: We logged your complaint about a listing, fee, or request handling. This is not a clinical complaints process.
